recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not re-add the direct-average note unless OO decides to restore an active mean blood pressure row; adding it now would duplicate historical guidance and work against the later FHIR-32788 cleanup of blood pressure supplement text.
issue_request: FHIR-11304 was a Published/Persuasive with Modification OO issue for the DSTU2 FHIR-core Vital Signs profile table. It asked to replace the mean blood pressure note "Will define this as Mean Arterial Pressure (MAP) = 2/3DP + 1/3SP" with "The mean blood pressure is most commonly a direct average taken off of an instrument."
initial_application: No explicit Jira-keyed commit for FHIR-11304 was found; a grep for 11304 in commit subjects only found an unrelated Subversion revision number. Git history shows the effective pre-application in 0d2d645db323246e3c7f844058f4fbf4dcbf62a9, which changed the mean blood pressure table row from the MAP formula to the direct-average note before the Jira vote/resolution was published.
additional_context: Observation is an active resource in source/fhir.ini, and implementationguide-Observation-vitalsigns.xml references observation-vitalsigns-profile-introduction.xml and observation-vitalsigns-profile-notes.xml. Later vital-signs table refactoring commented out the standalone mean blood pressure row while retaining the historical direct-average wording only in the commented row. The later Applied FHIR-32788 decision, already represented on the combined branch by d696144c4669d29fc0a67f35ea28e36e475f93e4, removed the active blood pressure supplement sentence that had listed 8478-0 Mean blood pressure.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Current active vital-signs table source contains no MAP formula and no active mean blood pressure note requiring replacement; the remaining mean blood pressure example uses the LOINC code/display without redefining the measurement method.

related_jiras.note: Later vital-signs table cleanup updated supplemental code guidance and is already represented on the combined branch.
Later OO decision removed the blood pressure supplement sentence that listed 8478-0 Mean blood pressure; its reconciliation commit is already on the combined branch.
